cross_product_finding: search:xattrs-mapping is now independently attested by a real, matching mechanism on BOTH sides of the product line: cloud/search/create-type-mapping.json states 'XATTRs mappings can only be created with Advanced Mode' (a UI-mode gate), while this Server page states the equivalent gate as a Server version requirement instead - 'Your cluster is running Couchbase Server version 7.6.2 or later' - with no UI-mode concept involved at all (Server's Web Console customize-index editor has no Quick/Advanced Mode split; that is Capella-specific). Same artifact, same reused candidate_id, two structurally different gating mechanisms (UI mode vs. product version) - a clean instance of the pattern this round's briefing set up to look for at the create-type-mapping.md diff-gate, found here on the page Server split the topic out into instead.
